guide_line: A covalent bond is orbital overlap. End-to-end overlap is sigma. Side-by-side overlap is pi. Count one sigma per bond, then add a pi for each extra bond.
steps: Valence bond theory says a covalent bond forms when a half-filled orbital on one atom overlaps a half-filled orbital on another. The shared pair is pulled toward both nuclei. More overlap makes a stronger bond.

The strongest overlap of p orbitals is end to end, along the line between the nuclei. Overlap of two s orbitals (H2), an s orbital with a p orbital (HF or HCl), or two p orbitals end to end (Cl2) is a sigma bond. Electron density sits on that line.
A pi bond is side-by-side overlap of p orbitals. The overlap sits above and below the line between the nuclei, and that line itself is a node.

The first bond between two atoms is always sigma. A single bond is that sigma only. A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi. A triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi. Add every bond in the molecule. Lone pairs are not bonds.

worked_example.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in H2?
steps: H2 has one single bond, from end-to-end overlap of the two 1s orbitals.
A single bond is 1 sigma and 0 pi.

similar_problem.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in O2?
similar_problem.hint: O2 has one double bond: 1 sigma plus 1 pi.

problems.q: The bond in H2 is overlap of two 1s orbitals along the line between the nuclei. Is that bond sigma or pi?
problems.why: End-to-end overlap puts the electron density on the line between the nuclei. That is a sigma bond. H2 has no pi bond.
hints: H2 overlaps two 1s orbitals along the line between the nuclei.
Overlap on that line is a sigma bond.

problems.q: Two 2p orbitals overlap side by side, above and below the line between the nuclei. Is that overlap sigma or pi?
problems.why: Side-by-side overlap of p orbitals leaves a node on the line between the nuclei. That overlap is a pi bond.
hints: Side-by-side p overlap sits off the line between the nuclei.
That off-axis overlap is a pi bond.

problems.q: Two chlorine atoms overlap 3p orbitals end to end. Is the Cl–Cl bond sigma or pi?
problems.why: End-to-end overlap of two p orbitals concentrates electron density along the Cl–Cl line. A single bond made that way is sigma.
hints: The Cl–Cl bond is end-to-end overlap of two 3p orbitals.
End-to-end p overlap is a sigma bond.

problems.q: Which fluorine orbital overlaps the hydrogen 1s orbital to make the H–F sigma bond?
problems.why: Fluorine uses a half-filled 2p orbital. End-to-end overlap of H 1s with F 2p is the sigma bond in HF.
hints: Fluorine’s valence p orbitals are in the second shell.
The H–F sigma bond uses a fluorine 2p orbital.

problems.q: Which chlorine orbital overlaps the hydrogen 1s orbital to make the H–Cl sigma bond?
problems.why: Chlorine’s half-filled valence orbital is a 3p orbital. End-to-end overlap of H 1s with Cl 3p is the sigma bond.
hints: Chlorine’s valence p orbitals are in the third shell.
The H–Cl sigma bond uses a chlorine 3p orbital.

problems.q: A pi bond has a node along the line between the two nuclei. True or false?
problems.why: In a pi bond the overlap is above and below the internuclear axis. The axis itself is a node, a place with no electron density from that bond.
hints: Pi overlap is off to the sides, not on the line between the nuclei.
That line is a node, so the statement is true.

problems.q: Between the same two atoms, which bond is always the first one formed, sigma or pi?
problems.why: The first overlap between two atoms is end to end, so it is sigma. A second or third bond, if there is one, is pi.
hints: The first overlap between two atoms lies along the line that joins them.
That first bond is sigma. Any extra bond is pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in Cl2?
problems.why: Cl2 has one single bond. That is 1 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: Cl2 has one single bond, so count only a sigma bond.
That one Cl–Cl bond is 1 sigma and 0 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in O2?
problems.why: O2 has one double bond. A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi.
hints: O2 has one double bond: 1 sigma plus 1 pi.
Count the second overlap of O=O as the pi bond.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in O2?
guided.hint: A double bond has one sigma bond.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in O2?
guided.hint: A double bond has one pi bond.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words.
guided.hint: O2 has 1 sigma and 1 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in N2?
problems.why: N2 has one triple bond. A triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: N2 has one triple bond: 1 sigma plus 2 pi.
The two extra overlaps in N≡N are both pi bonds.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in N2?
guided.hint: A triple bond starts with one sigma bond.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in N2?
guided.hint: The other two bonds in a triple bond are pi bonds.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words.
guided.hint: N2 has 1 sigma and 2 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in CO2?
problems.why: CO2 is O=C=O, two double bonds. Each double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, so the molecule has 2 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: Each C=O in CO2 is 1 sigma and 1 pi. Add both double bonds.
Two double bonds give CO2 two sigma bonds and two pi bonds.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in O=C=O?
guided.hint: Each double bond contributes one sigma bond.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in O=C=O?
guided.hint: Each double bond contributes one pi bond.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words, like "2 sigma, 2 pi".
guided.hint: Add the two double bonds: 2 sigma and 2 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in C2H4?
problems.why: C2H4 has four C–H single bonds and one C=C double bond. The double bond adds 1 sigma and 1 pi, so the total is 5 sigma and 1 pi.
hints: C2H4 has four C–H single bonds plus one C=C. Only the double bond adds a pi.
Four C–H sigma bonds plus one C=C sigma make 5 sigma and 1 pi.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in C2H4?
guided.hint: Four C–H bonds plus the sigma part of C=C is five.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in C2H4?
guided.hint: The double bond adds one pi bond.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words.
guided.hint: C2H4 has 5 sigma and 1 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in C2H2?
problems.why: C2H2 is H–C≡C–H: two C–H single bonds and one triple bond. The triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi, so the molecule has 3 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: C2H2 has two C–H single bonds and one C≡C. The triple bond adds two pi bonds.
Two C–H sigma bonds plus one C≡C sigma make 3 sigma and 2 pi.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in C2H2?
guided.hint: Two C–H bonds plus the sigma part of the triple bond is three.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in C2H2?
guided.hint: A triple bond has two pi bonds.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words.
guided.hint: C2H2 has 3 sigma and 2 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in HCN?
problems.why: HCN is H–C≡N: one C–H single bond and one triple bond. That is 2 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: HCN has one C–H single bond and one C≡N triple bond.
The C–H sigma plus the one sigma in C≡N make 2 sigma and 2 pi.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in H–C≡N?
guided.hint: The C–H bond is one sigma. The triple bond adds one more sigma.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in H–C≡N?
guided.hint: A triple bond has two pi bonds.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words.
guided.hint: HCN has 2 sigma and 2 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in CH2O?
problems.why: CH2O has two C–H single bonds and one C=O double bond. That is 3 sigma and 1 pi.
hints: CH2O has two C–H single bonds and one C=O. Only the double bond adds a pi.
Two C–H sigma bonds plus one C=O sigma make 3 sigma and 1 pi.

guided.prompt: How many sigma bonds are in CH2O?
guided.hint: Two C–H bonds plus the sigma part of C=O is three.

guided.prompt: How many pi bonds are in CH2O?
guided.hint: The double bond adds one pi bond.

guided.prompt: Write the sigma and pi counts as words.
guided.hint: CH2O has 3 sigma and 1 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in CH4?
problems.why: CH4 has four C–H single bonds and no multiple bond. That is 4 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: CH4 is only four C–H single bonds, so there is no extra overlap to count.
Four C–H bonds are 4 sigma and 0 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in C2H6?
problems.why: C2H6 has six C–H single bonds and one C–C single bond. All seven bonds are sigma, and there is no pi bond.
hints: C2H6 has six C–H bonds and one C–C bond, and every one of them is single.
Seven single bonds are 7 sigma and 0 pi.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in H2O?
problems.why: Water has two O–H single bonds. Lone pairs on oxygen are not bonds, so the count is 2 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: Water has two O–H single bonds. Do not count the lone pairs.
Two single bonds are 2 sigma and 0 pi.
